info.description:
Multi-tenant access control and smart building platform API.

All endpoints are tenant-scoped through the `Authorization: Bearer dm3_live_...`
or `dm3_test_...` API token. Issue tokens from Settings → API Integration.
Tokens prefixed `dm3_live_` act on production data; `dm3_test_` are sandbox.

The default rate limit is 60 requests/minute per token. Responses use a
consistent envelope: success responses return the resource directly, errors
return `{ "error": "<code>", "message": "<human readable>" }`.
info.title: Duall Master API

get.description: Returns paginated access event history for the caller's tenant. Supports filtering by access point, user, decision, credential type, and an ISO-8601 time window. Results are sorted newest first.

parameters.description: Filter by credential type (face, card, pin, qr, plate)
parameters.name: credential_type

get.description: Streams access event history for the caller's tenant as CSV or XLSX. Accepts the same filters as the list endpoint. Hard-capped at 50,000 rows per export.

parameters.description: Output format (csv or xlsx, default csv)
parameters.name: format

get.description: Access groups bundle access points + time templates + users. Paginated, filterable by name.

delete.description: Soft delete. Users currently assigned to this group keep their assignment records but those records become inactive.

get.description: Plugin-gated (attendance). Reads open to any attendance-enabled user.

parameters.description: Filter by year (defaults to current year)
parameters.name: year

get.description: Plugin-gated (attendance). Returns the caller's own attendance records over the requested window.

parameters.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) start of window. Defaults to first day of current month.
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) end of window. Defaults to today.
parameters.name: to

post.description: Submits a leave request for the authenticated user. Any caller-supplied user_id is ignored.

parameters.description: Leave request (policy_id, start_date, end_date, half_day, reason)
parameters.name: body

get.description: Streams matching audit log entries as CSV. Supports the same filters as list. Capped at 50,000 rows per export.
get.summary: Export audit log entries as CSV

parameters.description: Filter by tenant UUID (system admin only)
parameters.name: tenant_id

get.description: Returns a paginated list of audit log entries. Tenant users see only their own tenant's entries; system admins see all. Supports filtering by actor, service, action, entity_type, status, and time range.

parameters.description: Filter by tenant UUID (system admin only)
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.description: Filter by entity type (e.g. user, device)
parameters.name: entity_type

200.description: Paginated list with data and pagination envelope

get.description: Returns a single audit log entry by id. Tenant users can only read entries from their own tenant.

Returns every API token issued for the caller's tenant. The raw token
secret is only shown once at creation time; this endpoint returns the
non-secret metadata (prefix, scopes, usage counters, etc.).

post.description: Step-1 of the two-step login flow. If the user belongs to multiple companies, returns a list of companies instead of tokens and the caller must follow up with POST /auth/login-step2 specifying company_code. Rate-limited per IP.

200.description: Either { access_token, refresh_token, user } or { companies: [] } when disambiguation is needed

423.description: Account locked after 5 failed attempts (15 min cooldown)

post.description: Revokes the refresh token so it can no longer be exchanged. The access token continues to work until it expires naturally (short-lived).

get.description: Returns the caller's profile together with roles and tenant plugin config. Used by the console on every page load to hydrate the session.

post.description: Supports a 7-day grace period for expired refresh tokens so offline terminals can still sync. Rate-limited per IP.

get.description: System admin only. Each company is a tenant; the list controls who can log into the platform.

parameters.description: Partial match on name or code
parameters.name: search

post.description: System admin only. Creates a new tenant with its plugin config, seeds the tenant's dm3_* schema defaults, and optionally invites an initial admin user.

parameters.description: Company payload (name, code, plugins[], admin email, etc.)
parameters.name: body

put.description: Plugin toggles apply on the next user login for that tenant — existing sessions keep their old plugin set until their access token is refreshed.

delete.description: System admin only. Marks the tenant as suspended; existing sessions stay valid until their JWT expires but new logins are blocked.

get.description: Plugin-gated (cctv). Reads open to any cctv-enabled user; writes require cctv.camera.manage.

parameters.description: Filter by bound access point UUID
parameters.name: access_point_id

post.description: Registers an RTSP/WebRTC source. For Hanet integration, provide the Hanet device id instead of a raw RTSP URL.

parameters.description: Camera payload (name, type, rtsp_url or hanet_device_id, access_point_id, etc.)
parameters.name: body

get.description: Each row includes online status, firmware version, and a comma-separated list of the access points the device is bound to.

parameters.description: Filter by device id, name, or location
parameters.name: search

post.description: For production use, prefer the provisioning QR flow. This endpoint is a direct write for integrations that manage device inventory externally.

parameters.description: Device fields: device_id (hardware id, required), name, type, model, location, firmware_version
parameters.name: body

put.description: Partial update. Changes to verify_methods or open_relay_ms take effect after the next config sync cycle.

delete.description: Permanently removes the device. Any offline cached credentials on the device remain until it syncs and discovers it has been revoked.

get.description: Paginated list of users, filterable by search term, status, and department.

200.description: Paginated user list with total count

post.description: Creates a user record. Required fields are first_name, last_name, and either email or emp_number. Optional credentials (card, PIN, biometric) can be attached via the separate credentials endpoints.

parameters.description: User fields: first_name, last_name, email, phone, department_id, position, status, access_group_id, effective_date, expired_date
parameters.name: body

409.description: Email or employee number already exists

get.description: Fetch the full user record including department, access group membership, and credentials metadata.

404.description: User not found or not in tenant

put.description: Partial update — only fields present in the body are updated. Omit a field to leave it unchanged.

parameters.description: Subset of user fields to update
parameters.name: body

delete.description: Soft delete — the user record is marked deleted and hidden from list/get endpoints, but retained for audit integrity. Associated credentials are revoked immediately.

get.description: Plugin-gated (parking). A session is an entry/exit ticket. Reads open; writes require parking.ticket.manage.

parameters.description: Filter by session status (active, exited, voided)
parameters.name: status

get.description: Plugin-gated (parking). Reads open to any parking-enabled user; writes require parking.vehicle.manage.

parameters.description: Partial match on plate, owner name, or phone
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Vehicle payload (plate, owner_name, phone, vehicle_type, pass_id, etc.)
parameters.name: body

get.description: Plugin-gated (visitor). Requires visitor.visit.manage on writes; reads open to any visitor-enabled user.

post.description: Sends an email invitation to the visitor with a QR code if email is provided. Plugin-gated (visitor), requires visitor.visit.manage.

parameters.description: Visit payload (first_name, last_name, email, expected_arrival, host_user_id, etc.)
parameters.name: body

post.description: Captures arrival time and optional arrival metadata (photo, badge). Transitions visit.status to checked_in.

BearerAuth.description: API token in the form `Bearer dm3_live_...` or `Bearer dm3_test_...`.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
